sentence: Capsolutely ruins a real nonchalaura faster than asking for one.

wombos.definition: A sarcastic agreement that implies the opposite — used to call someone out for lying (capping) while appearing to agree. 'Cap' is internet slang for lying. Equivalent to 'yeah, sure, absolutely not.'
A cool, unbothered aura — the effortless, low-effort energy that someone naturally exudes without trying.
wombos.example: He didn't say a word the whole time, but his nonchalaura was immaculate.
